description:
Intent: remove the temporary coverage slack once the current tree proves the former 87 floor is supportable. Do not make this ticket depend on restoring a historical defer count or on preserving an old line universe.

Current measurement at 939fdacdf: cargo llvm-cov completed instrumentation and its report contains 87,072 covered of 97,750 lines = 89.0762%. cargo llvm-cov report --summary-only --fail-under-lines 87 passes. Only 11 defer lines remain across four fixtures, so the old premise (~23 deferred fixtures causing ~85%) no longer describes the tree. The full test invocation is separately red in the fixture matrix and tracked by fz-lfp plus the focused behavioral blockers; those failures do not justify leaving a coverage gate below the coverage actually exercised.

Acceptance: restore .coverage-threshold from 84 to 87 now; verify a fresh coverage report remains >=87 after the matrix is green; do not rebaseline downward for unrelated failures. No code or fixture deferral changes belong in this ticket.
title: Remove temporary coverage slack: restore the proven 87 line floor
